page.overview:
What is Glamrock Endo?

Glamrock Endo is a minor recurring character in the Tales from the Pizzaplex. They are the Endoskeletons of the Glamrock Animatronics.

In the Bobbiedots, Part 2 story, a group of Glamrock Endoskeletons is seen walking through the Sewers of the Pizzaplex. Abe doesn't know if they've hurt anyone.

In the Nexie, Endo Warehouse appears in the story. And at the end of the story, it is implied that Astrid's skin was put over a Glamrock Endoskeleton.
